Results of the meta-analysis showed no significant differences in muscle hypertrophy in the training durations evaluated. When considering just the studies that employed traditional dynamic constant external resistance (i.e., isotonic) training, it can be inferred that there are no discernable differences in hypertrophy using durations up to approximately 6 seconds.
